description: Revid turns an idea into a finished short-form video without leaving the chat. Give it a prompt, a script, an article URL, an audio file, or a music track, and Revid writes the script, generates the visuals, adds a voiceover and captions, and renders a vertical video ready for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. You can estimate the credit cost before rendering, check render progress, export the MP4, and schedule or publish the video to your connected social accounts. Revid also searches viral short-form videos across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Reddit, Threads, and LinkedIn so you can study what is working before you create. Requires a Revid account with an active plan; renders consume credits from your Revid account.

defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second vertical video about 3 surprising AI productivity tips, with a voiceover and captions.
Find viral TikToks about morning routines from the last week and summarize the hooks they use.
Estimate how many Revid credits a 45-second script-to-video with an avatar would cost before rendering it.
